# ash_typescript v0.17.3 - Table of Contents

Generate type-safe TypeScript clients directly from your Ash resources and actions, ensuring end-to-end type safety between your backend and frontend.

## Modules

- [AshTypescript.Codegen](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.Codegen.md): Main code generation module for TypeScript types and schemas from Ash resources.
- [AshTypescript.Codegen.FilterTypes](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.Codegen.FilterTypes.md): Generates TypeScript filter types for Ash resources.
- [AshTypescript.Codegen.Helpers](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.Codegen.Helpers.md): Shared helper functions for code generation.

- [AshTypescript.Codegen.ImportResolver](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.Codegen.ImportResolver.md): Resolves relative import paths between generated TypeScript files
and generates namespace re-export content.
- [AshTypescript.Codegen.Orchestrator](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.Codegen.Orchestrator.md): Coordinates multi-file TypeScript code generation with full cross-file deduplication.
- [AshTypescript.Codegen.ResourceSchemas](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.Codegen.ResourceSchemas.md): Generates TypeScript schemas for Ash resources.
- [AshTypescript.Codegen.SchemaCore](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.Codegen.SchemaCore.md): Shared logic for schema generation across all validation library targets.
- [AshTypescript.Codegen.SchemaFormatter](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.Codegen.SchemaFormatter.md): Behaviour defining the output-format interface for schema generators.
- [AshTypescript.Codegen.SharedSchemaGenerator](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.Codegen.SharedSchemaGenerator.md): Generates a shared validation schema file for any `SchemaFormatter` implementation.
- [AshTypescript.Codegen.SharedTypesGenerator](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.Codegen.SharedTypesGenerator.md): Generates the shared TypeScript types file (`ash_types.ts`).
- [AshTypescript.Codegen.SortTypes](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.Codegen.SortTypes.md): Generates TypeScript sort field `as const` arrays and derived union types for Ash resources.
- [AshTypescript.Codegen.TypeAliases](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.Codegen.TypeAliases.md): Generates TypeScript type aliases for Ash types (e.g., UUID, Decimal, DateTime, etc.).

- [AshTypescript.Codegen.TypeDiscovery](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.Codegen.TypeDiscovery.md): Discovers all types that need TypeScript definitions generated.
- [AshTypescript.Codegen.TypeMapper](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.Codegen.TypeMapper.md): Maps Ash types to TypeScript types using unified type-driven dispatch.
- [AshTypescript.Codegen.UtilityTypes](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.Codegen.UtilityTypes.md): Generates TypeScript utility types for field selection and type inference.
- [AshTypescript.Codegen.ValibotSchemaGenerator](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.Codegen.ValibotSchemaGenerator.md): Generates Valibot validation schemas for Ash resources and actions.
- [AshTypescript.Codegen.ZodSchemaGenerator](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.Codegen.ZodSchemaGenerator.md): Generates Zod validation schemas for Ash resources and actions.
- [AshTypescript.FieldFormatter](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.FieldFormatter.md): Handles field name formatting for input parameters, output fields, and TypeScript generation.
- [AshTypescript.Helpers](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.Helpers.md): Utility functions for string manipulation and transformations.

- [AshTypescript.Resource](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.Resource.md): Spark DSL extension for configuring TypeScript generation on Ash resources.
- [AshTypescript.Resource.Info](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.Resource.Info.md): Provides introspection functions for AshTypescript.Resource configuration.
- [AshTypescript.Resource.Verifiers.VerifyFieldNames](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.Resource.Verifiers.VerifyFieldNames.md): Verifies that resource field names are valid for TypeScript generation.
- [AshTypescript.Resource.Verifiers.VerifyMapFieldNames](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.Resource.Verifiers.VerifyMapFieldNames.md): Verifies that field names in map, keyword, and tuple type constraints are valid for TypeScript.
- [AshTypescript.Resource.Verifiers.VerifyMappedFieldNames](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.Resource.Verifiers.VerifyMappedFieldNames.md): Verifies that field_names configuration is valid.
- [AshTypescript.Resource.Verifiers.VerifyUniqueTypeNames](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.Resource.Verifiers.VerifyUniqueTypeNames.md): Checks that all resources using AshTypescript.Resource have unique type_name values.

- [AshTypescript.Rpc.Codegen](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.Rpc.Codegen.md): Generates TypeScript code for interacting with Ash resources via Rpc.

- [AshTypescript.Rpc.Codegen.FunctionGenerators.ChannelRenderer](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.Rpc.Codegen.FunctionGenerators.ChannelRenderer.md): Renders Channel-specific TypeScript functions (handler-based, Phoenix channels).
- [AshTypescript.Rpc.Codegen.FunctionGenerators.FunctionCore](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.Rpc.Codegen.FunctionGenerators.FunctionCore.md): Builds the common "shape" of RPC functions, independent of transport.
- [AshTypescript.Rpc.Codegen.FunctionGenerators.HttpRenderer](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.Rpc.Codegen.FunctionGenerators.HttpRenderer.md): Renders HTTP-specific TypeScript functions (Promise-based, fetch).
- [AshTypescript.Rpc.Codegen.FunctionGenerators.JsdocGenerator](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.Rpc.Codegen.FunctionGenerators.JsdocGenerator.md): Generates JSDoc comments for RPC functions.
- [AshTypescript.Rpc.Codegen.FunctionGenerators.TypeBuilders](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.Rpc.Codegen.FunctionGenerators.TypeBuilders.md): Builds TypeScript type definitions for RPC function results and configurations.
- [AshTypescript.Rpc.Codegen.FunctionGenerators.TypedQueries](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.Rpc.Codegen.FunctionGenerators.TypedQueries.md): Generates TypeScript typed query types and field constants.
- [AshTypescript.Rpc.Codegen.Helpers.ActionIntrospection](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.Rpc.Codegen.Helpers.ActionIntrospection.md): Provides helper functions for analyzing Ash actions.
- [AshTypescript.Rpc.Codegen.Helpers.ConfigBuilder](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.Rpc.Codegen.Helpers.ConfigBuilder.md): Builds TypeScript configuration field definitions for RPC functions.
- [AshTypescript.Rpc.Codegen.Helpers.PayloadBuilder](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.Rpc.Codegen.Helpers.PayloadBuilder.md): Builds TypeScript payload field definitions for RPC function implementations.
- [AshTypescript.Rpc.Codegen.JsonManifestGenerator](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.Rpc.Codegen.JsonManifestGenerator.md): Generates a machine-readable JSON manifest of all RPC actions.
- [AshTypescript.Rpc.Codegen.ManifestGenerator](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.Rpc.Codegen.ManifestGenerator.md): Generates a Markdown manifest of all RPC actions for discoverability.
- [AshTypescript.Rpc.Codegen.RpcConfigCollector](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.Rpc.Codegen.RpcConfigCollector.md): Collects RPC configuration from domains including resources, actions, and typed queries.

- [AshTypescript.Rpc.Codegen.TypeGenerators.InputTypes](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.Rpc.Codegen.TypeGenerators.InputTypes.md): Generates TypeScript input types for RPC actions.
- [AshTypescript.Rpc.Codegen.TypeGenerators.MetadataTypes](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.Rpc.Codegen.TypeGenerators.MetadataTypes.md): Generates TypeScript metadata types for RPC actions.
- [AshTypescript.Rpc.Codegen.TypeGenerators.PaginationTypes](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.Rpc.Codegen.TypeGenerators.PaginationTypes.md): Generates TypeScript pagination result types for RPC actions.
- [AshTypescript.Rpc.Codegen.TypeGenerators.RestrictedSchema](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.Rpc.Codegen.TypeGenerators.RestrictedSchema.md): Generates restricted resource schemas based on allowed_loads/denied_loads options.
- [AshTypescript.Rpc.Codegen.TypeGenerators.ResultTypes](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.Rpc.Codegen.TypeGenerators.ResultTypes.md): Generates TypeScript result types for RPC actions.
- [AshTypescript.Rpc.Codegen.TypescriptStatic](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.Rpc.Codegen.TypescriptStatic.md): Generates static TypeScript code that doesn't depend on specific resources.
- [AshTypescript.Rpc.DefaultErrorHandler](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.Rpc.DefaultErrorHandler.md): Default error handler for RPC operations.
- [AshTypescript.Rpc.Error](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.Rpc.Error.md): Protocol for extracting minimal information from exceptions for RPC responses.
- [AshTypescript.Rpc.ErrorBuilder](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.Rpc.ErrorBuilder.md): Comprehensive error handling and message generation for the new RPC pipeline.
- [AshTypescript.Rpc.ErrorHandler](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.Rpc.ErrorHandler.md): Behaviour for custom RPC error handlers.
- [AshTypescript.Rpc.Errors](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.Rpc.Errors.md): Central error processing module for RPC operations.
- [AshTypescript.Rpc.FieldExtractor](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.Rpc.FieldExtractor.md): Unified field extraction for different data structures.
- [AshTypescript.Rpc.FieldProcessing.Atomizer](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.Rpc.FieldProcessing.Atomizer.md): Handles preprocessing of requested fields, converting map keys to atoms
while preserving field name strings for later reverse mapping lookup.
- [AshTypescript.Rpc.FieldProcessing.FieldSelector](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.Rpc.FieldProcessing.FieldSelector.md): Unified field selection processor using type-driven recursive dispatch.
- [AshTypescript.Rpc.FieldProcessing.FieldSelector.Validation](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.Rpc.FieldProcessing.FieldSelector.Validation.md): Field validation helpers for the FieldSelector module.
- [AshTypescript.Rpc.Info](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.Rpc.Info.md): Provides introspection functions for AshTypescript.Rpc configuration.
- [AshTypescript.Rpc.InputFormatter](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.Rpc.InputFormatter.md): Formats input data from client format to internal format.
- [AshTypescript.Rpc.OutputFormatter](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.Rpc.OutputFormatter.md): Formats output data from internal format to client format.
- [AshTypescript.Rpc.Pipeline](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.Rpc.Pipeline.md): Implements the four-stage pipeline:
1. parse_request/3 - Parse and validate input with fail-fast
2. execute_ash_action/1 - Execute Ash operations
3. filter_result_fields/2 - Apply field selection
4. format_output/2 - Format for client consumption

- [AshTypescript.Rpc.Request](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.Rpc.Request.md): Request data structure for the new RPC pipeline.
- [AshTypescript.Rpc.RequestedFieldsProcessor](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.Rpc.RequestedFieldsProcessor.md): Processes requested fields for Ash resources, determining which fields should be selected
vs loaded, and building extraction templates for result processing.
- [AshTypescript.Rpc.Resource](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.Rpc.Resource.md): Struct representing a resource's RPC configuration.
- [AshTypescript.Rpc.ResultProcessor](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.Rpc.ResultProcessor.md): Extracts requested fields from RPC results using type-driven dispatch.
- [AshTypescript.Rpc.RpcAction](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.Rpc.RpcAction.md): Struct representing an RPC action configuration.
- [AshTypescript.Rpc.TypedQuery](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.Rpc.TypedQuery.md): Struct representing a typed query configuration.
- [AshTypescript.Rpc.ValidationErrorSchemas](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.Rpc.ValidationErrorSchemas.md): Generates validation error schemas for TypeScript RPC clients.
- [AshTypescript.Rpc.ValueFormatter](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.Rpc.ValueFormatter.md): Unified value formatting for RPC input/output.
- [AshTypescript.Rpc.Verifiers.VerifyActionTypes](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.Rpc.Verifiers.VerifyActionTypes.md): Verifies that field names in action return types and argument types are valid for TypeScript.
- [AshTypescript.Rpc.Verifiers.VerifyIdentities](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.Rpc.Verifiers.VerifyIdentities.md): Verifies that all identities listed in RPC actions actually exist on the resource.
- [AshTypescript.Rpc.Verifiers.VerifyMetadataFieldNames](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.Rpc.Verifiers.VerifyMetadataFieldNames.md): Verifies that metadata field names in RPC actions are valid TypeScript identifiers
and don't conflict with existing resource field names.

- [AshTypescript.Rpc.Verifiers.VerifyTypedQueryFields](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.Rpc.Verifiers.VerifyTypedQueryFields.md): Verifies that all requested fields in typed queries reference valid, public fields
on the resource and that the field selections are structurally correct.
- [AshTypescript.Rpc.Verifiers.VerifyUniqueInputFieldNames](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.Rpc.Verifiers.VerifyUniqueInputFieldNames.md): Verifies that all input fields for each RPC action have unique client names.
- [AshTypescript.Rpc.VerifyRpc](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.Rpc.VerifyRpc.md): Checks that all RPC actions and typed queries reference existing resource actions,
and validates that names don't contain invalid patterns.

- [AshTypescript.Rpc.VerifyRpcWarnings](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.Rpc.VerifyRpcWarnings.md): Outputs warnings for potentially misconfigured RPC resources during compilation.
- [AshTypescript.TypeSystem.Introspection](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.TypeSystem.Introspection.md): Core type introspection and classification for Ash types.
- [AshTypescript.TypeSystem.ResourceFields](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.TypeSystem.ResourceFields.md): Provides unified resource field type lookup.
- [AshTypescript.TypedChannel](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.TypedChannel.md): Standalone Spark DSL for typed Phoenix channel event subscriptions from
Ash PubSub publications.
- [AshTypescript.TypedChannel.Codegen](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.TypedChannel.Codegen.md): Generates TypeScript types and functions for typed channel event subscriptions.
- [AshTypescript.TypedChannel.Dsl](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.TypedChannel.Dsl.md): Spark DSL extension for defining typed Phoenix channel event subscriptions.
- [AshTypescript.TypedChannel.Dsl.ChannelResource](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.TypedChannel.Dsl.ChannelResource.md): Represents an Ash resource whose publications are subscribed to.
- [AshTypescript.TypedChannel.Dsl.Publication](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.TypedChannel.Dsl.Publication.md): Represents a declared channel event subscription.
- [AshTypescript.TypedChannel.Info](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.TypedChannel.Info.md): Provides introspection functions for AshTypescript.TypedChannel configuration.

- [AshTypescript.TypedChannel.Verifiers.VerifyTypedChannel](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.TypedChannel.Verifiers.VerifyTypedChannel.md): Verifies that typed channel configurations are valid.
- [AshTypescript.TypedController](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.TypedController.md): Standalone Spark DSL for defining typed controller routes.
- [AshTypescript.TypedController.Codegen](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.TypedController.Codegen.md): Entry point for TypeScript path helper code generation.
- [AshTypescript.TypedController.Codegen.RouteConfigCollector](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.TypedController.Codegen.RouteConfigCollector.md): Discovers all TypedController modules from application configuration.

- [AshTypescript.TypedController.Codegen.RouteRenderer](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.TypedController.Codegen.RouteRenderer.md): Generates TypeScript functions for typed controller routes.
- [AshTypescript.TypedController.Codegen.RouterIntrospector](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.TypedController.Codegen.RouterIntrospector.md): Introspects a Phoenix Router to match routes to generated controllers.
- [AshTypescript.TypedController.Codegen.TypescriptStatic](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.TypedController.Codegen.TypescriptStatic.md): Generates static TypeScript code for typed controller routes.
- [AshTypescript.TypedController.Dsl](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.TypedController.Dsl.md): Spark DSL extension for defining typed controller routes.
- [AshTypescript.TypedController.Dsl.Route](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.TypedController.Dsl.Route.md): Struct representing a route configuration.
- [AshTypescript.TypedController.Dsl.RouteArgument](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.TypedController.Dsl.RouteArgument.md): Struct representing a route argument configuration.

- [AshTypescript.TypedController.Info](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.TypedController.Info.md): Provides introspection functions for AshTypescript.TypedController configuration.

- [AshTypescript.TypedController.RequestHandler](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.TypedController.RequestHandler.md): Handles request lifecycle for typed controller routes.
- [AshTypescript.TypedController.Route](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.TypedController.Route.md): Behaviour for typed controller route handlers.
- [AshTypescript.TypedController.Transformers.GenerateController](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.TypedController.Transformers.GenerateController.md): Spark transformer that generates a Phoenix controller module at compile time.
- [AshTypescript.TypedController.Verifiers.VerifyTypedController](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.TypedController.Verifiers.VerifyTypedController.md): Verifies that typed controller configurations are valid.
- [AshTypescript.VerifierChecker](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/AshTypescript.VerifierChecker.md): Checks if any verifiers have failed for resources and domains.

## Mix Tasks

- [mix ash_typescript.codegen](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.AshTypescript.Codegen.md): Generates TypeScript types for Ash Rpc-calls.
- [mix ash_typescript.install](https://ash-typescript.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.AshTypescript.Install.md): Installs AshTypescript into a project. Should be called with `mix igniter.install ash_typescript`
